scope: Read-only static audit of the actual boot Image and current ACPI description; no UART traffic or new boot trial
method: Read-only mount of boot partition, hash guard, AArch64 objdump of raw Image; function offsets derived from running kernel kallsyms relative to _text; unmounted in finally

selected_image_evidence.observation: Loads port device; sets x1 to all 64 bits one; calls dma_set_mask at 0x737ab8. Nonzero return branches to error reporting and cleanup.
NUL-terminated string: Unable to set dma mask\n; referenced by probe error path at 0x737ac8-0x737ad0.
Success path calls dma_set_coherent_mask with all 64 bits one, then dma_alloc_attrs for 4096 bytes; uart_add_one_port is later at 0x737bc4.
Returns zero for NULL, otherwise extracts bit 11 from flags at device offset 116.
Returns zero when flags bit 11 is clear; otherwise returns 1 plus bit 10.
For attr zero, writes address at Image-relative 0xe5c468 (dma_dummy_ops per kallsyms) to device offset 568, and returns success.
ACPI branch calls acpi_get_dma_attr followed by acpi_dma_configure_id.
Returns -5 if dma_mask pointer is NULL or the selected dma_supported callback returns false.
Reviewed function body. Called before dma_set_mask with integer arguments 2 and serial_id. Contains MMIO mapping/writes; does not receive device pointer. This audit did not execute it.

header_crosscheck: Installed linux-headers-6.6.10/include/acpi/acpi_bus.h declares coherent_dma at bit 10 and cca_seen at bit 11. Headers alone are not proof of all running-kernel layouts.
interpretation: Missing applicable _CCA is strongly supported as a cause of DMA rejection, not proof of absent hardware DMA. Exact live dma_ops/cca_seen values during failed probe were not captured. No coherent/noncoherent value has been established for UART4.
limits: No vendor UART source found in installed headers or matching source filenames in supplied MTT_E300 reference project.
No PIO fallback on the reviewed probe DMA-failure path; this does not prove every driver function lacks PIO.
Clock rate, pinmux, interrupt and DMA routing still need vendor-board configuration evidence.
A raw Image function-pointer slot read as zero before boot relocation; it was not used as live pointer evidence.
No /proc/kcore access, runtime module load, firmware edit, _CCA patch, reboot, SDK execution or power request.
